strings.zh: 你！{NEWLINE}从城都地区来的啊！
strings.en: You! You’re from Johto!
strings.notes: 关东急速联盟 → the Kanto Speed Alliance (Cycling Road bike gang; also 0351, 0570, 0718). Invented.

strings.zh: 好强……！
strings.en: So strong...!

strings.zh: 不可原谅,居然被{NEWLINE}城都地区的家伙小看了！
strings.en: Unforgivable! Being looked down on by{NEWLINE}some punk from Johto!
strings.notes: | RV013: meaning: 小看 = look down on

strings.zh: 喂！你是哪来的！{NEWLINE}这里可是我们「关东急速联盟」的地盘,{CLEAR}你不准靠近,给我回去！
strings.en: Hey! Where’d you come from? This is the{NEWLINE}turf of the Kanto Speed Alliance!{CLEAR}You’re not allowed near here. Go back!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我有急事要去浅红市,{NEWLINE}请你让我过去！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I have urgent business in{NEWLINE}Fuchsia City. Please let me through!
strings.notes: #4/#5: alternate player lines (polite / firm). #9 (male) / #10 (female, 本姑娘) player variants.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我有急事要去浅红市,{NEWLINE}要是耽误了,你可付不起责任,{CLEAR}赶紧让开！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I have urgent business in{NEWLINE}Fuchsia City. If you hold me up, you{CLEAR}can’t afford the consequences. Get out{CLEAR}of the way!
strings.notes: [D-2069 meaning-review-30: independently LLM-reviewed source-faithful correction; not human-approved.]

strings.zh: 哼,有急事的人多着呢,{NEWLINE}你让我让开我就让开？{SCROLL}我们「关东急速联盟」的面子{NEWLINE}还要不要了？
strings.en: Hmph! Lots of people have urgent{NEWLINE}business. You think I’ll just move{CLEAR}because you tell me to?{SCROLL}What about the Kanto Speed Alliance’s{NEWLINE}reputation?

strings.zh: 是否硬闯？
strings.en: Force your way through?

strings.zh: 哼,算你识相,滚回去吧！
strings.en: Hmph! Smart choice. Now scram!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『事情紧急,{NEWLINE}你再不让开我就硬闯了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This is an emergency.{SCROLL}If you don’t move, I’m going through by{NEWLINE}force!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这里是公用道路,{NEWLINE}你霸占着路不让走还有理了？{CLEAR}再不让开当心本姑娘不客气！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This is a public road! Blocking{NEWLINE}it and acting like you’re in the right?{CLEAR}If you don’t move, this girl won’t go{CLEAR}easy on you!

strings.zh: 看来不给你点颜色看看{NEWLINE}你是不会回去了！
strings.en: Looks like you won’t go back until I{NEWLINE}teach you a lesson!

strings.zh: 哼哼,你赢了我又怎么样。{NEWLINE}我们这么多伙伴在这座桥上,{CLEAR}他们绝不会轻易放你过去的！{SCROLL}虽然我不知道你有什么急事,{NEWLINE}但是跟我们「关东急速联盟」过不去,{CLEAR}你就休想按时通过这条自行车之路！
strings.en: Hmph, so what if you beat me? We’ve got{NEWLINE}lots of members on this bridge. They{CLEAR}won’t let you pass so easily!{SCROLL}I don’t know what your urgent business{NEWLINE}is, but if you cross the Kanto Speed{CLEAR}Alliance, you can forget about getting{CLEAR}down this Cycling Road on time!

strings.zh: 虽然我不知道你有什么急事,{NEWLINE}但是跟我们「关东急速联盟」过不去,{CLEAR}你就休想按时通过这条自行车之路！
strings.en: I don’t know what your urgent business{NEWLINE}is, but if you cross the Kanto Speed{CLEAR}Alliance, you can forget about getting{CLEAR}down this Cycling Road on time!

strings.zh: 听老大说你的实力比他还强,{NEWLINE}看来输给你,我也没什么可丢人的。
strings.en: The boss said you’re even stronger{NEWLINE}than him. Guess there’s no shame in{CLEAR}losing to you.

strings.zh: 欢迎加入我们「关东急速联盟」,{NEWLINE}能跟你这么强的人当伙伴,{CLEAR}我感到很荣幸。
strings.en: Welcome to the Kanto Speed Alliance!{NEWLINE}It’s an honor to have someone as{CLEAR}strong as you as a buddy.

strings.zh: 看来你是铁了心{NEWLINE}要跟我们「关东急速联盟」作对了。{CLEAR}我虽然不是你的对手,{CLEAR}但你也不可能击败我们所有的伙伴！
strings.en: Looks like you’re dead set on going up{NEWLINE}against the Kanto Speed Alliance. I’m no{CLEAR}match for you, but there’s no way you{CLEAR}can beat all our members!

strings.zh: 呜呜……都是你害的！{NEWLINE}这里不再是只属于我们的自由王国了。
strings.en: Waaah... This is all your fault! This{NEWLINE}isn’t our own free kingdom anymore.

strings.zh: 不用再憋在角落里骑车,真好！
strings.en: It’s great not having to ride cooped up{NEWLINE}in a corner anymore!

strings.zh: 这条路的路障终于清理了,{NEWLINE}这下骑车的感觉就通透了。
strings.en: The roadblocks on this road have finally{NEWLINE}been cleared.{SCROLL}Riding here feels so free now.

strings.zh: 在宽宽的自行车道上骑车,{NEWLINE}感觉真不错。
strings.en: Riding on the wide Cycling Road feels{NEWLINE}great.

strings.zh: 在这里骑车,{NEWLINE}上坡的时候格外累人呢。
strings.en: Riding here gets really tiring on the{NEWLINE}uphill parts.

strings.zh: 不知道那些暴走族发了什么善心,{NEWLINE}居然会放弃霸占自行车道。
strings.en: I wonder what got into those bikers.{NEWLINE}They actually gave up hogging the{CLEAR}Cycling Road.

strings.zh: 我老早就想来这里{NEWLINE}痛痛快快地骑一回了。
strings.en: I’ve wanted to come ride here to my{NEWLINE}heart’s content for ages.

strings.zh: 此路禁止通行,{NEWLINE}「关东急速联盟」封。
strings.en: No entry. By order of the Kanto Speed{NEWLINE}Alliance.

strings.zh: 往前走是没有意义的,{NEWLINE}前面的路被暴走族给封死了。
strings.en: There’s no point going on. The bike gang{NEWLINE}has blocked the road ahead.

strings.zh: 你很厉害吗？{NEWLINE}闯进暴走族的底盘可不是闹着玩的。
strings.en: You think you’re tough? Barging into{NEWLINE}the bike gang’s turf is no joke.

strings.zh: 我已经尽力反抗暴走族了,{NEWLINE}虽然以失败告终。{CLEAR}但我没有遗憾！
strings.en: I did my best to stand up to the bike{NEWLINE}gang. I failed, but I have no regrets!
